analysis.insight_summary: Users asked whether data logging to the cloud is available with [product_name] [version_no]. Responses confirmed that cloud data logging is supported, with documentation and practical workshop links provided to assist users with integrating cloud data logging.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] [version_no] to offer straightforward and well-documented data logging capabilities directly to a cloud service.
